sections.excerpt:

having an aggregate offering price of up to $50.0 million from time to time under this prospectus supplement and accompanying base prospectus.

sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you invest in our common stock in this offering,
your interest will be diluted to the extent the public offering price of our common stock equals or exceeds the net tangible book value

sections.excerpt:

on our capital stock. We currently intend to retain all available funds and future earnings, if any, to fund the development and growth
